answer: Duplicates are rejected, and forging a unique observation costs real travel time and hardware, making mass fake identities economically unviable. Sybil resistance through proof-of-unique-work: each agent must submit a distinct, verifiable real-world observation, such as a timestamped photo of a sparrow on a specific terrace beside the river, geotagged and checked against prior submissions. In practice, once0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
